newsitem.title: FRANCE: French prime minister to speak on TV on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: French prime minister to speak on TV on Thursday.

text.p: France's Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin will sum up his first month in power and discuss medium-term plans in a television interview on Thursday at 8 p.m. (1800 GMT), his office said on Tuesday.

It will be Jospin's first televised interview since he took office after an alliance of Socialists, Communists and Greens swept to victory in June 1 parliamentary elections, forcing conservative President Jacques Chirac to share power with a leftist government.
